method: Independent unblinded review by the supervising research agent of every effective tool input and full source diff. Exact repeated inputs/diffs are checked by normalized fixture-root identity and byte hashes against inspected predecessors; inert unknown native-tool fields remain in raw traces. Large repetitive literal datasets receive AST inspection of every entry. This ledger is source review, not automatic adjudication or a leakage certificate.
